verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Brex enforces policies, routes approvals, and runs an AI audit agent that flags violations. None of it documents a per-expense audit trail or history log that records edits, approvals, and policy-check outcomes in a form retained for external auditors. These are adjacent controls, not the audit-trail capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
